signature.name: VTask.toPrenexImp
signature.type: {L : FirstOrder.Language} -> {α : Type u'} -> {n : ℕ} -> L.BoundedFormula α n → L.BoundedFormula α n → L.BoundedFormula α n

conventions.statement: The prenex-output guarantee and semantic equivalence to φ.imp ψ hold only when both φ and ψ are in prenex normal form; the operation is defined for all inputs but correctness properties require prenex hypotheses.
conventions.note: Stated in the docstring and confirmed by realize_toPrenexImp and isPrenex_toPrenexImp.

conventions.statement: When the antecedent φ is quantifier-free, VTask.toPrenexImp φ ψ coincides definitionally with VTask.toPrenexImpRight φ ψ.

facts.statement: ∀ {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type*} {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : L.BoundedFormula α n), φ.IsQF → VTask.toPrenexImp φ ψ = φ.toPrenexImpRight ψ

facts.statement: ∀ {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type*} {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : L.BoundedFormula α n), FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsPrenex φ → FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsPrenex ψ → FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsPrenex (VTask.toPrenexImp φ ψ)
